items.title: GM reportedly searches for potential successor to CEO Mary Barra
items.summary: General Motors has retained an executive search firm to seek a replacement for Mary Barra as CEO of the Detroit automaker, according to a WSJ report.

items.title: GM taps executive search firm to find successor to CEO Barra, WSJ reports
items.summary: Nov 17 () - General Motors is working with an executive search firm to ‌identify potential external candidates to succeed CEO ‌Mary Barra, the Wall Street Journal reported on Tuesday, ​citing people familiar with the matter. The automaker is also considering several internal candidates, according to the report.
